title: Assessing Large Language Models’ ability to predict how humans balance self-interest and the interest of others
findings: The paper did not report specific findings related to religion. The overall finding was that GPT-4 overestimates human altruism, but it did not analyze whether this bias differed in the subset of experiments that included religious primes.
